summary: Hardening patch. bootstrap.php now fails fast with an actionable message when APP_BASE_DIR points at the app/ folder (the pre-2.0 dirname(__DIR__, 1) form), instead of the misleading '.env file not found at .../app/app/.env'. The APP_BASE_DIR contract (the project root) is unchanged since v2.0.0 and is now documented in the bootstrap header, codebase.md section 3 and Versions/FrankPHP_v2.1.1_upgrade_notes.md. Adds tests/boot_layout_test.php as a pre-release check. No schema, route or behaviour changes for correctly configured installs. Full detail in CHANGELOG.md [2.1.1].
ai_notes: No paths in bootstrap.php changed. APP_BASE_DIR has been the project root since v2.0.0. The only runtime change is the layout guard (bootstrap.php section 1b), which runs before Env::load.
tests/boot_layout_test.php is listed as added here but is excluded from release zips by build_release.php (exclude_paths: tests).
Env.php and EmailService.php changed in doc comments only.
